railroad_name: HART Railroad, Pittsburgh & Chartiers Valley Division

routing_instructions.North Yard:
SY1 yardmaster staging.
Cars for island industries or South Yard classification.
routing_instructions.West Yard: SY1 yardmaster retrieves and stages cars.
routing_instructions.Scully Yard: POHC interchange — NVL set out outbound; pick up inbound.
routing_instructions.East Yard:
Coke storage — CK-1 to South Yard when authorized.
SY1 yardmaster staging.
routing_instructions.Neville Island: Island locals — NVL spots and pulls at Aristech, Stucki, Calgon, Ferrel, and Kosmos.
routing_instructions.South Yard:
Classification hub for D749 and NVL.
Inbound CSX for D749 (Demmler); POHC for NVL (Scully).
Industry-bound locals for NVL.
routing_instructions.Demmler Yard: CSX interchange — D749 set out outbound; pick up inbound.

jobs.name: D749
jobs.description:
CSX Neville Island Switcher.
- Demmler Yard: Pick up for Scully Yard
- Demmler Yard: Pick up for Neville Island
- South Yard: Set out inbound; Pick up for Demmler Yard
- Demmler Yard: Set out outbound

steps.remarks: Pick up inbound for Scully Yard
Pick up inbound for Neville Island
Set out inbound; Pick up outbound for Demmler Yard
Set out outbound at Demmler Yard

jobs.name: NVL
jobs.description:
POHC Neville Local.
- Scully Yard: Pick up for Neville Island and Demmler Yard
- South Yard: Set out; Pick up Neville Island block
- Neville Island: Spot and pull for island, Scully, and Demmler
- South Yard: Set out; Pick up for Scully Yard
- Scully Yard: Set out outbound

steps.remarks: Pick up inbound for Neville Island
Pick up inbound for Demmler Yard
Set out; Pick up Neville Island block
Island work — pick up for Neville Island, Scully Yard, and Demmler Yard
Set out; Pick up outbound for Scully Yard
Set out outbound at Scully Yard

jobs.name: SY1
jobs.description:
South Yard yardmaster (SY1) — inter-island switching on Neville Island.
Retrieve and stage cars across North, East, and West yards for island industries.
Sort inbound traffic and build outbound blocks for CSX D749 (via Demmler) and POHC NVL (via Scully).
D749 and NVL handle industry spotting and interchange; SY1 works the satellite yards only.

steps.remarks: Pick up inbound cars from D749 and NVL for classification
Retrieve and stage cars at North Yard
Retrieve and stage cars at East Yard
Retrieve and stage cars at West Yard
Build NVL industry block; stage CSX block for D749 (Demmler) and POHC block for NVL (Scully)

jobs.name: CK-1
jobs.description:
Coke transfer — optional yard move.
Move coke loads from East Yard to South Yard for weighing and classification when authorized and traffic warrants.
Run only when it will not interfere with NVL or passenger movements.

steps.remarks: Pick up coke loads at East Yard
Set out coke loads at South Yard for weighing/classification

jobs.name: CKX
jobs.description:
Coke extra — optional outbound coke move.
Depart South Yard with weighed coke loads when enough cars are ready.
May run via CSX (Demmler) or POHC as directed by car routing.

steps.remarks: Pick up weighed coke loads at South Yard
Set out coke for CSX at Demmler Yard
